items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...One leg. ... You can't recall his first name.

ctx.x: Alexei, yeah. He had a style of his own, too. He played in the district, you know, all kind of old blues and stuff. Oh, yeah. Yeah. He was a pretty old man. He was way older than me. Jesus. That little boy, he was a man playing. He must have been 30 years old then. When I was 10 or 12, something like that. Yeah. He had to be about 30. He was pretty old. Yeah. One leg.
Yeah, yeah. One leg. One leg. Yeah. You can't recall his first name.

Yeah, but I was trying to get his first name. Nobody hardly ever used it, but I didn't know it. His first name. It was a real old time. Did you? Some little Robertson. Did you get him? Robertson? Robertson piano. What's his first name? Samla. Samla? No. Samla. That's another old timer. What?
